top_choice_rationale: P001 credits the original idea (Katori's magic-wavelength lattice and first strontium lattice clock) and the decisive demonstration (Ye's 10^-18 systematics, redshift and many-body measurements), reproduced independently at RIKEN, JILA, NIST, PTB, SYRTE and NPL. It is distinct from the 2005 comb and 2012 ion-control prizes, and the two-name allocation is one I can defend as the original work. P002 is a deep, verified discovery but bundles QSH and QAH, and I cannot be sure the three names capture the right people given Mele, Hasan and the BHZ proposal. It still ranks above no award, because the science is sound and mature.
recusal_note: none apparent from profile; only general field proximity to condensed-matter and materials work, with no link to Katori, Ye, Kane, Molenkamp or Xue
